_about: Native Windows only: manifest.json's steps with FELIX's three no-ffmpeg / scipy patches added in FELIX's place, after simple_failover (felix-framework aea841ffd dependencies.json order). Native Windows has no ffmpeg; WSL and Mac keep it and use manifest.json. Selected by apply.py --native-windows. tests/test_native_manifest.py keeps the two lists in step.

steps.why: never cut active speech at listen_duration_max
stop the turns[] playback thread on cancel (upstream PR #555)
no silent OpenAI voice swap; configurable STT timeout
no false 'voice will fail' warning without ffmpeg
import scipy.signal at start, not mid-recording (voicemode#545)
a distinguishable session name in the conch
push-to-talk hold in the recording loop
German voices get German text only
live playback state and barge_in; uses the hold patches' text when present
modules go in before the pill patch makes converse import them
pill state, session registration, Pause and Stop; needs voice barge first
push-to-talk cuts TTS generation, records at once, a stop clears the hold; needs hold, barge and pill
named-pipe control channel where AF_UNIX is missing; needs control_transport.py
MCP tool for switching voice barge-in
close temp audio files before deleting them; Windows refuses to delete an open file (WinError 32)
the session label uses the client's folder; voice-mode itself runs in the runtime folder
